author: TeIq
content:
CLOSED as DOCUMENTED-ARCHITECTURAL. Ozone-to-Polaris migration depends on a real Ozone Postgres schema dump for source-reader binding + mapping validation + integration testing. The issue body's per-PR spec (typed OzoneXxxRow structs, mapping with MappingError, migration_state idempotency, CLI binary + verify subcommand, audit-log boundary, cutover runbook, fixture dataset) is the implementation guide for an operator with Ozone-access who picks this up.

Architectural pieces that don't need Ozone-access (the v1 file-plain signing key being Ozone-compatible by design, the audit-log integration pattern, the polaris-types side of the mapping bridge) are captured by the existing v1 work + this epic's design doc at .design/m5/46-ozone-migration.md.
